title: 18256 - 18256/P1848/006216
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fault Code(s) stored in Engine Control Unit
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Control Unit for Fault Codes
technicalNotes: This fault code is a note since the system it is stored in interacts with the Engine Control Unit and due to a fault code there it may not be fully functional.
